definitions.gloss: chewy; firm; having a good bite; al dente
definitions.explanation: Describes noodles, mochi, or other starchy foods that have a pleasantly firm, springy texture — not soft or mushy. A desirable quality in Japanese noodle culture.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腰|こし}がある。
examples.english: These udon noodles are nice and chewy.

examples.japanese: {讃岐|さぬき}⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}くて→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧、{歯|は}ごたえ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Sanuki udon has a strong chewiness and great bite.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧ here refers to the "body" or "backbone" of the noodle — its resilience and springiness. The opposite is ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (soft, lacking firmness). Variations include ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (very firm) and ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{麺|めん}→麺：14644_men⟧ (firm noodles, using the attributive form).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{麺|めん}→麺：14644_men⟧ (firm noodles)
- ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (very firm/chewy)
- ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (soft, lacking firmness — negative)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Firmness (⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧) is considered a key quality indicator for udon and soba. {讃岐|さぬき}⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧ from Kagawa Prefecture is famous for its strong ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧. The concept is similar to Italian "al dente" for pasta.
